grammar.summary: 本课讲拳击手门多萨的兴衰史，语法上突出被动语态（be known as, be adored, be defeated, be sent to prison）、was/were + 过去分词及 not until 强调结构，以及 so...that... 结果状语从句。叙述中兼用 who/when/where 定语从句交代人物背景。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: be + 过去分词突出承受者。本课大量被动：were known as（被称为）、was adored（被崇拜）、was defeated（被击败）、was sent to prison（被送进监狱），把门多萨的起落写成客观叙述，突出「被命运摆布」之感。

examples.en: Because of this, they were known as 'prizefighters'.
examples.cn: 因此，他们被称作“职业拳击手”。

examples.en: He was adored by rich and poor alike.
examples.cn: 无论是富人还是穷人都对他祟拜备至。

examples.en: He was sent to prison for failing to pay his debts and died in poverty in 1836.
examples.cn: 他因无力还债而被捕入狱，最后于1836年在贫困中死去。

points.title: not until 强调结构 (Emphatic not until)
points.explanation: It is/was not until... that... 表示「直到……才……」，强调某动作直到某时才发生。本课 It was not until his third match in 1790 that he finally beat Humphries 强调他直到第三次才胜出，时间状语被提前以突出。

examples.en: It was not until his third match in 1790 that he finally beat Humphries and became Champion of England.
examples.cn: 直到1790年他们第3次对垒，门多萨才终于击败汉弗莱斯，成了全英拳击冠军。

points.title: so...that... 结果状语从句 (Result Clauses)
points.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句，表「如此……以至于……」。本课 so extravagant that he was always in debt 表示「挥霍到总是负债的地步」，用 so 修饰形容词 extravagant，that 引出结果。

examples.en: Despite this, he was so extravagant that he was always in debt.
examples.cn: 尽管收入不少，但他挥霍无度，经常债台高筑。

exercises.q: Because of this, they ______ known as 'prizefighters'.（被动语态）
It was ______ until his third match in 1790 that he finally beat Humphries and became Champion of England.（强调结构）
Despite this, he was ______ extravagant that he was always in debt.（结果状语从句）
用被动语态填空：He was ______ by rich and poor alike.（写出 adore 的过去分词）
下列哪个词与课文中 extravagant 的含义最接近？
